bootstrap_unit: Named site, with all age groups, procedures and years resampled together within each evaluated population.
review_budget_ties: At each exact report review capacity, equal-score reports at the boundary contribute fractionally, giving expected alert capture under uniform random selection within that score tie. This avoids arbitrary sorting of tied comparator values.
AP: Average precision, using distinct score thresholds and stepwise recall increments.
calibration: Observed report-alert fraction by prediction decile, with site-cluster confidence intervals. Predictions remain frozen from training; no recalibration applied.
evaluation: Repeated annual reports remain grouped within site for uncertainty. Counts of procedures/SSI events describe exposure, and are not independent prediction sample size.
